extraction.title_anon: Inquiry into fake motor accident claims, Uttar Pradesh (interim order, no award)
extraction.family_summary: This order decides no compensation: it is part of a Supreme Court case on fake road accident and workmen's compensation claims filed in Uttar Pradesh. A special police team had received 1,376 suspicious claims and registered 92 criminal cases, naming 28 advocates as accused, and the Bar Council of India suspended 28 advocates. Tricks listed include passing off other deaths or injuries as road accidents and planting a vehicle or driver. On 16 December 2021 the Court asked the Union transport ministry for suggestions before giving directions for all of India.
what_mattered: No claim was decided: the Court only recorded the police and Bar Council action and asked the Union transport ministry for suggestions before any all-India directions.
Insurers said earlier Supreme Court directions, such as police sending an accident report to the tribunal and insurer within 48 hours, were not being followed.
